prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create an original premium abstract photographic optical light artwork for an indie photo and video editing tool campaign whose identity is additive red green blue light on deep graphite black. Portrait 4:5 composition, no text, no lettering, no logos, no interface, no people, no objects implying product hardware. In a black optical space a sculptural translucent folded glass ribbon catches three distinct narrow red, green, blue beams; overlap of colored light produces cool white highlights, delicate spectral caustics and grain. Restrained vivid RGB colors (#FF3B30 #30D158 #3282FF), luminous white, rich near-black. Tangible light and beautiful photographic detail, experimental darkroom spirit, elegant editorial composition, not a rainbow gradient wallpaper. Main glass form occupies lower two thirds with generous dark negative space at top for later typesetting. Art-directed, high-end creative studio campaign quality. Standalone original artwork, no imitation of specific artist.
role: Abstract brand imagery; no product interface or product result
